title: Jesus' Healing Ministry and Miracles

questions.question: When Jesus came down from the mountain, a leper came, knelt before Him, and said what?
options: "Lord, if you will, you can make me clean."
"Lord, give me alms."
"Lord, have mercy on my soul."
"Lord, make my skin as a newborn's."
questions.correctAnswer: "Lord, if you will, you can make me clean."
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:2 (ESV): "and behold, a leper came to him and knelt before him, saying, 'Lord, if you will, you can make me clean.'"

questions.question: What did Jesus physically do when he healed the leper, saying "I will; be clean"?
options: He stretched out his hand and touched him
He laid his staff upon him
He threw water from a skin on him
He poured oil on his head
questions.correctAnswer: He stretched out his hand and touched him
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:3 (ESV): "And Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, 'I will; be clean.'"

questions.question: When Jesus entered Capernaum, a centurion came appealing to Him for whom?
options: His servant, who was paralyzed at home and suffering terribly
His daughter, who was dead
His wife, who was bleeding
His soldier, who was blind
questions.correctAnswer: His servant, who was paralyzed at home and suffering terribly
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:5-6 (ESV): "a centurion came forward to him, appealing to him, 'Lord, my servant is lying paralyzed at home, suffering terribly.'"

questions.question: What did the centurion tell Jesus to do to heal his servant, because he felt unworthy to have Jesus under his roof?
options: "But only say the word, and my servant will be healed."
"But pray to your God from here."
"But send one of your disciples."
"But write a command for him."
questions.correctAnswer: "But only say the word, and my servant will be healed."
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:8 (ESV): "But the centurion replied, 'Lord, I am not worthy to have you come under my roof, but only say the word, and my servant will be healed.'"

questions.question: How did Jesus respond to the centurion's faith?
options: He marveled and said, "With no one in Israel have I found such faith."
He said to Peter, "Learn from this Gentile."
He was angered by his pride
He laughed, saying it was impossible from a distance
questions.correctAnswer: He marveled and said, "With no one in Israel have I found such faith."
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:10 (ESV): "When Jesus heard this, he marveled and said to those who followed him, 'Truly, I tell you, with no one in Israel have I found such faith.'"

questions.question: Whose mother-in-law did Jesus heal of a fever by touching her hand?
options: Peter's
James's
John's
Matthew's
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:14-15 (ESV): "And when Jesus entered Peter's house, he saw his mother-in-law lying sick with a fever. He touched her hand, and the fever left her..."

questions.question: Matthew points out that Jesus' healing fulfilled Isaiah's words: "He took our illnesses and bore our _____."
options: Diseases
Iniquities
Sins
Pain
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:17 (ESV): "This was to fulfill what was spoken by the prophet Isaiah: 'He took our illnesses and bore our diseases.'" (quoting Isaiah 53:4)

questions.question: When a scribe said he would follow Jesus anywhere, how did Jesus reply about His living condition?
options: "Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head."
"I have no gold or silver to give you."
"My home is in the heavenly places."
"Those who follow me must carry a cross."
questions.correctAnswer: "Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head."
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:20 (ESV): "And Jesus said to him, 'Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.'"

questions.question: What did Jesus say to the disciple who asked to first go and bury his father?
options: "Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead."
"Go, and return after the time of mourning is complete."
"Blessed are those who mourn."
"Only a son may honor his father thus."
questions.correctAnswer: "Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead."
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:22 (ESV): "But Jesus said to him, 'Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.'"

questions.question: What was Jesus doing in the boat when a great storm arose on the sea?
options: He was sleeping
He was praying aloud
He was helping bail water
He was teaching the crowd on the shore
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:24 (ESV): "And behold, there arose a great storm on the sea, so that the boat was being swamped by the waves; but he was sleeping."

questions.question: What did Jesus say to the disciples who woke Him up terrified of drowning?
options: "Why are you afraid, O you of little faith?"
"Do not awaken me until we reach the shore."
"Have you forgotten my miracles already?"
"Peace be with you."
questions.correctAnswer: "Why are you afraid, O you of little faith?"
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:26 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'Why are you afraid, O you of little faith?' Then he rose and rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm."

questions.question: How did the men react after Jesus rebuked the winds and the sea, making a great calm?
options: They marveled, saying "What sort of man is this, that even winds and sea obey him?"
They fell down and kissed his feet in relief
They began to sing hymns of praise
They immediately cast their nets into the calm waters
questions.correctAnswer: They marveled, saying "What sort of man is this, that even winds and sea obey him?"
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:27 (ESV): "And the men marveled, saying, 'What sort of man is this, that even winds and sea obey him?'"

questions.question: When Jesus arrived in the country of the Gadarenes, two demon-possessed men met Him coming out of the what?
options: The tombs
The temple
The forest
The caves by the sea
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:28 (ESV): "...two demon-possessed men met him, coming out of the tombs, so fierce that no one could pass that way."

questions.question: What did the demons beg Jesus to do if He cast them out?
options: "Send us away into the herd of pigs."
"Send us into the abyss."
"Allow us to wander the desert."
"Let us enter these children here."
questions.correctAnswer: "Send us away into the herd of pigs."
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:31 (ESV): "And the demons begged him, saying, 'If you cast us out, send us away into the herd of pigs.'"

questions.question: After the herd of pigs rushed into the sea and died, what did all the city do when they came out and saw Jesus?
options: They begged Him to leave their region
They brought all their sick to be healed
They invited Him to the synagogue
They paid Him for the lost pigs
questions.correctAnswer: They begged Him to leave their region
questions.explanation: Matthew 8:34 (ESV): "And behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus, and when they saw him, they begged him to leave their region."

key_verse_text: And he said to them, "Why are you afraid, O you of little faith?" Then he rose and rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.
